title: Edmund and the Archive
author: Zephyrine Thornbury
blurb: Mara Vane, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
